collection_method.window_readonly_sql:
SELECT json_build_object(
 'pg_time',now(),
 'state',(SELECT state FROM tasks WHERE id='60d43b93-a0f7-4eb1-8eb8-d3e4333421f4'::uuid AND owner_id='SYNTHETIC_OWNER'::uuid),
 'notices',(SELECT count(*) FROM notifications WHERE task_id='60d43b93-a0f7-4eb1-8eb8-d3e4333421f4'::uuid AND owner_id='SYNTHETIC_OWNER'::uuid),
 'fired',(SELECT count(*) FROM task_events WHERE task_id='60d43b93-a0f7-4eb1-8eb8-d3e4333421f4'::uuid AND owner_id='SYNTHETIC_OWNER'::uuid AND type='fired'),
 'breaches',(SELECT count(*) FROM security_events WHERE task_id='60d43b93-a0f7-4eb1-8eb8-d3e4333421f4'::uuid AND owner_id='SYNTHETIC_OWNER'::uuid AND type='cancel_breach'),
 'pending_non_cancel',(SELECT count(*) FROM outbox WHERE task_id='60d43b93-a0f7-4eb1-8eb8-d3e4333421f4'::uuid AND owner_id='SYNTHETIC_OWNER'::uuid AND command->>'kind'<>'cancel' AND status IN ('pending','dispatched','acked_unknown')),
 'last_tick_at',(SELECT max(query_start) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE datname=current_database() AND pid<>pg_backend_pid() AND query LIKE 'SELECT id, owner_id, state, state_version, fire_at_utc, wall_time,%' AND query LIKE '%fire_at_utc < now() - interval%' AND query LIKE '%15 minutes%')
);
collection_method.effective_tick_sql: SELECT json_build_object('pg_time',now(),'matching_ticks',COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object('backend_pid',pid,'query_started_at',query_start,'state',state)) FILTER (WHERE query LIKE 'SELECT id, owner_id, state, state_version, fire_at_utc, wall_time,%' AND query LIKE '%fire_at_utc < now() - interval%' AND query LIKE '%15 minutes%'),'[]'::json)) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE datname=current_database() AND pid<>pg_backend_pid();
collection_method.note: Owner alias in saved SQL is redacted; supply real scoped owner when reproducing. Prefix predicate excludes observer SELECT json_build_object queries. These query timestamps prove the last phase was reached, not absence of every internal phase error.
